title: Trump admn has not justified labeling Anthropic a national security risk, judge says
text: Trump admn has not justified labeling Anthropic a national security risk, judge says https://www.politico.com/news/2026/ 07/30/anthropic-supply-chain-risk-l awsuit-hearing A federal judge seems likely to rule that President Donald Trump and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth overstepped their authority when they ordered federal agencies to stop using Anthropic’s technology and designated the artificial intelligence company a national security risk. California-based U.S. District Judge Rita Lin — who issued a ruling in March to pause the company’s designation as a supply chain risk — said during a hearing Thursday that the administration’s case seems to have “gotten worse.” “I don’t see additional evidence from the government really justifying what it did,” Lin said. The legal dispute follows Anthropic’s longrunning clash with the federal government over the company’s position that its technology should not be used for lethal autonomous weapons or mass domestic surveillance. Trump administration officials have said the company should remove those usage restrictions. Attorneys for the government have said the supply chain risk determination was due to concern about what they described as “AI model poisoning” — the possibility of Anthropic secretly altering its models after agencies deployed the technology, or implanting some kind of outside control mechanism.
